body: The owner accepted V1-0808 (ticket attach-evidence, TEA-V0-001) on 2026-10-05 with these items NOT_RUN; V1-0808 completes on that basis. title: corvint-tasks attach-evidence: witness archive round trip, concurrent CAS and interrupted-commit redo (V1-0808 follow-up)
